name: MDBList
description: Syncs watched status and ratings two-way between Jellyfin and MDBList, and pushes library/collection membership to MDBList. Uses MDBList's incremental sync API (last_activities + journal) for cheap, cursor-based updates instead of full-library reconciliation on every run.
overview: Two-way sync of watched status and ratings, plus collection sync, against MDBList

versions.changelog:
1.0.0.6: Fixes hitting MDBList's rate limit on a large first sync -- requests are now paced under the server's short-window write budget, and a 429 is retried using the server's own requested wait instead of aborting the whole sync. Also fixes losing sync progress if a run is interrupted: push progress is now saved per-batch instead of only at the end, so a later failure no longer forces redoing already-pushed items.

1.0.0.5: Fixes watched-status sync: a rewatch that only updated the watch date (without changing watched/unwatched membership) could be silently dropped by the scheduled full sync, and would only reach MDBList via the immediate live-playback push.

1.0.0.4: Fixes a build issue where the plugin was compiled against a newer Jellyfin ABI (10.11.11) than the declared minimum (10.11.0), causing installs to fail with "Status: NotSupported" on Jellyfin 10.11.1 through 10.11.10.

1.0.0.3: Fixes "Disconnect" always showing a failure alert even though it always succeeded. Updates the plugin catalog icon to a full-bleed 16:9 image instead of a square logo that Jellyfin's plugin page was cropping.

1.0.0.2: Fixes the plugin catalog icon's URL -- 1.0.0.1 published one with no host, which Jellyfin couldn't fetch at all.

1.0.0.1: Fixes scheduled syncs, "Sync now", and live scrobbling only ever acting on the first linked user when multiple Jellyfin users each have their own MDBList account connected. Adds a plugin catalog icon.

1.0.0.0: Initial release. Two-way sync of watched status and ratings, push-only collection sync, live playback scrobbling to MDBList's /scrobble endpoints, OAuth device-code authentication, incremental cursor-based pulls with automatic full-reconciliation fallback, a 24h scheduled full sync plus a 15-minute activity-gated cheap poll, and a config page for connecting your account and choosing what to sync.
